title: Woe to the Complacent

questions.question: Woe to those who are at ease in Zion, and to those who feel secure on the mountain of where?
questions.explanation: Amos 6:1 (ESV): "Woe to those who are at ease in Zion, and to those who feel secure on the mountain of Samaria,"

questions.question: They lie on beds of ivory and stretch themselves out on their what?
questions.explanation: Amos 6:4 (ESV): "Woe to those who lie on beds of ivory and stretch themselves out on their couches,"

questions.question: They drink wine in bowls and anoint themselves with what?
questions.explanation: Amos 6:6 (ESV): "who drink wine in bowls and anoint themselves with the finest oils,"

questions.question: But they are not grieved over the ruin of whom?
questions.explanation: Amos 6:6 (ESV): "but are not grieved over the ruin of Joseph!"

questions.question: I abhor the pride of Jacob and hate his what?
questions.explanation: Amos 6:8 (ESV): "I abhor the pride of Jacob and hate his strongholds,"

questions.question: Pass over to Calneh, and see, and from there go to Hamath the great; then go down to Gath of the whom?
questions.explanation: Amos 6:2 (ESV): "then go down to Gath of the Philistines."

questions.question: They sing idle songs to the sound of the harp and like whom do they invent for themselves instruments of music?
questions.explanation: Amos 6:5 (ESV): "who sing idle songs to the sound of the harp and like David invent for themselves instruments of music,"

questions.question: Therefore they shall now be the first of those who go into what?
questions.explanation: Amos 6:7 (ESV): "Therefore they shall now be the first of those who go into exile,"

questions.question: And if ten men remain in one house, they shall what?
questions.explanation: Amos 6:9 (ESV): "And if ten men remain in one house, they shall die."

questions.question: Do horses run on rocks? Does one plow there with what?
questions.explanation: Amos 6:12 (ESV): "Does one plow there with oxen?"

questions.question: When a man's relative... brings the bones out of the house, and says to him who is in the innermost parts of the house, "Is there still anyone with you?" he shall say, "No"; and he shall say, "Silence! We must not..."?
options: Mention the name of the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: Mention the name of the Lord
questions.explanation: Amos 6:10 (ESV): "We must not mention the name of the Lord."

questions.question: For behold, the Lord commands, and the great house shall be struck down into fragments, and the little house into what?
questions.explanation: Amos 6:11 (ESV): "and the little house into bits."

questions.question: You have turned justice into poison and the fruit of righteousness into what?
questions.explanation: Amos 6:12 (ESV): "But you have turned justice into poison and the fruit of righteousness into wormwood--"

questions.question: You who rejoice in Lo-debar, who say, "Have we not by our own strength taken whom for ourselves?"
questions.explanation: Amos 6:13 (ESV): "Have we not by our own strength taken Karnaim for ourselves?"

questions.question: I will raise up against you a nation, O house of Israel... and they shall oppress you from Lebo-hamath to the Brook of where?
questions.explanation: Amos 6:14 (ESV): "and they shall oppress you from Lebo-hamath to the Brook of the Arabah."

key_verse_text: Woe to those who are at ease in Zion, and to those who feel secure on the mountain of Samaria, the notable men of the first of the nations, to whom the house of Israel comes!
